data.text: test/package.test.ts scans dist for /(?:from\s*|require\()\s*["'][^"']+["']/ to find undeclared dependencies. It cannot tell an import from prose: the sentence 'In progress counts from "in_progress"' in a template literal made the suite report a dependency on ${e.started}. Reworded rather than loosening the regex - the guard is worth more than the phrasing - but the next person to write from "..." in a user-facing string will hit it too.
